why: First case of a heuristic, and its N/A side is only writable because the runner started reading state: `na` and `passou` both exit 0, so while the verdict came from the exit code this side could not be declared. The `does not use shadcn` branch is what stops the heuristic from demanding cva and tailwind-merge from someone who never chose shadcn. `pass/` is a React project without `components.json`; `fail/` has the `components.json` and a manifest with no primitive, no cva and no tailwind-merge, and it keeps warning — the read guard of this rule comes AFTER the N/A on purpose, so that whoever does not use shadcn does not earn a warning over a broken manifest. `na` and `passou` stay Portuguese: they are the state values prove.mjs matches on (prove.mjs:198-200), not prose.
